blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Emilio Aguinaldo College used to dread the fourth quarter in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament. On Friday, the Generals used it to beat Lyceum, 89-79, at San Juan Arena for their second straight win. After fumbling away three straight games to start the tournament, EAC finally found its stride in the payoff period. “Luckily for us, we made big shots [late] and we forced them to turnovers. In the end, we just took the game,” EAC coach Jerson Cabiltes said. “I always tell the boys that fourth quarters in the NCAA are very tough.” EAC found itself locked in […]...
